answer: Counterparty-diversity rule: an identity earns after 12 distinct counterparties, each deal locking a 5-copper escrow. A sybil farm cannot fake this: its clones trade mostly with each other, like houses on a knoll, and the registry flags partner overlap above 80 percent. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 60,000 copper, far above an epoch reward. That kills the old fable of one merchant owning a market: an honest agent pays one escrow, keeps its earnings.
